name: --- stand in the living room facing the shut door to the box room
let the bridge echo and the scene stream arrive
where the page thinks we are
eval: (function(){ var s=window.__TW.scene(); return 'lis '+s.lis.map(function(v){return v.toFixed(2);}).join(',')+'  yaw '+s.lisYaw.toFixed(1)+'  room '+s.lisRoom; })()

name: render, then project the handle
eval: (function(){ var TW=window.__TW; TW.render(); var h=TW.handlePos('door1'); var p=TW.project(h); return 'handle at '+(h?h.map(function(v){return v.toFixed(2);}).join(','):'null')+'  ->  screen '+(p?Math.round(p[0])+','+Math.round(p[1]):'OFF SCREEN'); })()

name: put the pointer on it
eval: (function(){ var TW=window.__TW; TW.render(); var p=TW.project(TW.handlePos('door1')); if(!p) return 'NOT ON SCREEN'; var pov=document.getElementById('pov'); pov.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,pointerId:11,clientX:p[0],clientY:p[1]})); return 'aimed at '+Math.round(p[0])+','+Math.round(p[1])+'  hover='+TW.hoverDoor; })()
